contenders.handicapper_notes: Ideal setup mapped from barrier 1 on Taree tight triangular layout. Rates as the clear top pick with Anna Roper steering.

Progressive 4yo mare coming off strong Grafton form, winning her maiden over 1000m and missing by a long-neck in Class 1 grade. Drawn ideally in stall 3 to jump and sit on the speed. Jean Van Overmeire takes the reins.

Brings superior Tier 2 Provincial formlines through Gosford and Wyong. Flashed home for 2nd over 1000m at Port Macquarie carrying 60.5kg last start. Wide draw is the only hurdle, but apprentice claim and class edge make him a primary threat.
